coverage.method: Compare distinct persisted catalogue physical groups within each v14 product. Each group must contain RX0 and RX1 tracklets on the same channel and edge; both groups must have overlapping UTC support.
coverage.limitation: Only catalogue groups persisted among each product bounded attempted groups are covered. group_limit=4 and physical_group_count is often larger, so this is not an all-RF-group or exact same-visit exclusion.
coverage.exact_same_visit_reconstruction: The five longest dual-RX pairs were reconstructed; no four-distinct-track same-channel/edge candidate shared at least two visits.

conclusion: No same-channel/edge two-source DD candidate exists among persisted catalogue groups in the 75 complete products. This does not exclude candidates among unpublished RF groups.
